name: Contentverse
description_en: Contentverse is Computhink’s document and process management product. It combines indexed records with access control, revision history and routed work. Its client choice matters: browser, installed Enterprise and mobile experiences have different dependencies and document operations. Deployment can be on-premises, hosted or hybrid, with named and concurrent users considered in the configuration. The assigned product path currently redirects to Computhink’s Contentverse homepage.
description_zh: Contentverse 是 Computhink 的文档与流程管理产品，将索引记录与访问控制、修订历史及流转任务结合。客户端选择很重要：浏览器、已安装 Enterprise 与移动端的依赖及文档操作有所不同。部署可为本地、托管或混合，配置时可考虑实名及并发用户。分配的产品路径当前跳转至 Computhink 的 Contentverse 首页。

sections.title_en: Follow the document and its next responsible person
sections.title_zh: 跟踪文档及下一位责任人
sections.en:
Contentverse combines a document repository with workflow, search, versions and audit information. Its homepage presents upload/organization, collaboration and controlled access as connected stages. That makes it an option to evaluate when the business question concerns both the record and the action still waiting on it.

For an editorial pilot, use a synthetic equipment inspection record with equipment ID, inspection date, responsible team and a revision needing review. Define whether a successful outcome means finding the record, accepting its revision or completing a follow-up action. Then inspect the document identity and process status together. A visible file alone does not prove its inspection was approved, and a completed notification does not prove its recipient took action. No document or workflow was created in this research.
sections.zh:
Contentverse 将文档库与工作流、检索、版本及审计信息结合。首页把上传整理、协作及受控访问呈现为相连阶段。因此，当业务问题同时涉及记录及仍待执行的动作时，可考虑评估。

编辑建议的试点可用虚构设备检查记录，设置设备标识、检查日期、责任团队及需审修订。先定义成功是找到记录、接受修订，还是完成后续动作，再同时检查文档身份及流程状态。文件可见不证明检查已获批准，通知完成也不证明接收者已行动。本研究未创建文档或工作流。

sections.title_en: Readable text is an input to validation
sections.title_zh: 可读文本是验证的输入
sections.en:
The August 2026 OCR article distinguishes recognized text from validated business data. For Contentverse it describes full-text processing, extraction into index fields, database lookups and automated filing. The Automated Input Processor holds exceptions separately for validation rather than treating every imported value as accepted.

For the proposed inspection, include an unclear equipment number and a missing date. Compare the source with the stored fields, inspect the exception path and decide which person may correct the record before routing it. An OCR match does not establish that an identifier exists in the equipment register, nor that the uploaded page belongs to the selected inspection. Test the downstream search and assignment after correction. No OCR run, accuracy benchmark or integration was executed; the article’s description of verified capabilities remains a vendor statement.
sections.zh:
2026 年 8 月 OCR 文章区分识别文本与经验证业务数据，并描述 Contentverse 的全文处理、索引字段提取、数据库查找及自动归档。自动输入处理器把异常单独保留待验证，不代表每个导入值都被接受。

建议设备检查样例应包含模糊设备号及缺失日期。将来源与存储字段比较，检查异常路径，并确定谁可在路由前修正记录。OCR 匹配不确立标识存在于设备台账，也不证明上传页面属于所选检查。修正后还需测试下游检索和分配。本研究未执行 OCR、准确率测量或集成；文章所谓已验证能力仍属厂商陈述。

sections.title_en: Identify the client before promising an edit
sections.title_zh: 承诺编辑能力前先确定客户端
sections.en:
Professional is not simply a no-action reader: the plans and feature text include adding documents, comments and assigned workflow actions, despite another summary calling it read-only. Enterprise has broader document changes. Browser Office editing depends on authorized Office Online Server deployment. Offline work and later sync are advertised, but conflict handling was not established.

For the inspection pilot, demonstrate the exact operator client and entitlement with the intended file type. Verify opening, modifying, saving and another person seeing the correct revision, then test an interrupted connection on synthetic content if offline work is needed. A format stored by the repository does not prove every client can preview or edit it natively. Obtain the current compatibility and supported-server requirements before installation. No client, Office server, mobile app or offline session was installed or used.
sections.zh:
Professional 不能简单视为无操作读者：套餐和功能文字包含新增文档、评论及分配到的工作流动作，尽管另一处摘要称其只读。Enterprise 可进行更广的文档修改。浏览器 Office 编辑依赖获授权的 Office Online Server 部署。官网宣传离线工作后同步，但未确立冲突处理。

设备检查试点应使用目标文件类型演示精确操作客户端及权益，核对打开、修改、保存以及其他人看到正确修订。若需离线，应再用虚构内容测试连接中断。资料库可存储一种格式，不证明每个客户端都可原生预览或编辑。安装前需取得当前兼容性及受支持服务器要求。本研究未安装或使用客户端、Office 服务器、移动应用或离线会话。

sections.title_en: Confirm what a redaction or revision actually preserves
sections.title_zh: 确认遮盖及修订实际保留什么
sections.en:
The feature page says version creation can be configured by document type and prior-version access by permissions. It describes password-protected redaction as guarding information without permanently removing it. A drawn or typed signature can also be burned into an image. These operations have different purposes and should not be treated as interchangeable evidence controls.

For the synthetic inspection, compare the authorized current revision with the historical copy and a shared output. Check whether sensitive text remains in another rendition, search result or older version before treating redaction as safe disclosure. A visible signature mark does not by itself establish signer identity or legal validity. Establish restoration, approval-reset and deleted-record behavior in the actual configured system; no full recovery procedure was found in the public support page. No redaction, signature, deletion or restore was performed.
sections.zh:
功能页说明版本创建可按文档类型配置，旧版访问受权限控制；密码保护的遮盖用于保护信息，而不会永久移除底层内容。手绘或输入的签名还可烧录至图像。它们用途不同，不应作为可互换的证据控制。

建议检查记录测试应比较授权当前修订、历史副本及共享输出。将遮盖视为安全披露前，应检查其他呈现、检索结果或旧版本是否仍含敏感文本。可见签名标记本身不确立签署身份或法律效力。实际系统中还需确定恢复、审批重置及已删记录行为；公开支持页未提供完整恢复流程。本研究未执行遮盖、签署、删除或恢复。

sections.title_en: Quote server, client, maintenance and hosting separately
sections.title_zh: 分别确认服务器、客户端、维护及托管报价
sections.en:
The plans page supports named and concurrent users and quotes configuration-based pricing. Actual browser reading showed no numeric price; repeated unqualified $100 text in the reader is not used. Professional and Enterprise lists differ, so compare required operations and simultaneous access rather than just headcount.

The sales terms require an EULA during setup, describe perpetual licenses and a separate active maintenance arrangement for maintenance/support, and require a Hosting Addendum for hosting. They also describe extra Content Sentinel seats restricted to external Sentinel use; these are not general free internal seats. Exact order applicability and the full EULA were not verified. Confirm server components, optional capture modules, maintenance, hosting, migration and taxes before estimating the total. Perpetual use does not mean free upgrades or an open-source grant. No quote, EULA acceptance, purchase or installation occurred.
sections.zh:
套餐页支持实名及并发用户，按配置询价。实际浏览器读取未显示数值价格，读取器中重复出现的无单位 100 美元不采用。Professional 与 Enterprise 列表不同，比较时需结合所需操作及同时访问人数，而非只看总人数。

销售条款要求安装时接受 EULA，描述永久许可，并对维护支持要求另有有效维护安排；托管还需 Hosting Addendum。条款还描述额外 Content Sentinel 席位，仅供外部 Sentinel 使用，不能当作通用免费内部席位。精确订单适用性及完整 EULA 未核实。估算总额前需明确服务器组件、可选采集模块、维护、托管、迁移与税。永久使用不等于免费升级或开源授权。本研究未询价、接受 EULA、购买或安装。

sections.title_en: Support contact data and document storage have different scope
sections.title_zh: 支持联系数据与文档存储范围不同
sections.en:
The support page is a contact and remote-session entry, not an open recovery manual. Its form states a two-year personal-data deletion period. That statement concerns the form, not every document held in an organization’s Contentverse repository. No support session or message was started.

The privacy policy separately discusses website registration, logs, service providers and CV Mobile. Mobile data access can depend on feature and customer configuration, with examples including camera, contacts, calendar and location; it does not establish that every device requests all of them. For the inspection pilot, establish what the selected client sends, the chosen hosting region, tenant retention, export format and backup/restoration owner. A mobile permission notice cannot substitute for that agreement. Full tenant deletion deadlines, application recovery and export fidelity remain unverified.
sections.zh:
支持页是联系及远程会话入口，不是公开恢复手册。其表单说明个人信息两年删除期，但该声明针对表单，不针对组织 Contentverse 资料库中的每份文档。本研究未启动支持会话或发送消息。

隐私政策另述网站注册、日志、服务提供方及 CV Mobile。移动数据访问可受功能及客户配置影响，例子包括相机、联系人、日历及位置，不证明每台设备均请求全部权限。设备检查试点应明确所选客户端发送什么、托管地区、租户保留、导出格式及备份恢复责任人。移动权限通知不能代替相关协议。完整租户删除期限、应用恢复及导出保真仍未核实。

seo.title_en: Contentverse: Client Differences, Capture Validation and License Scope
seo.title_zh: Contentverse：客户端差异、采集验证与许可范围
seo.description_en: Evaluate Contentverse using client-specific editing, exception validation, configurable revisions, nonpermanent redaction and quote-based deployment.
seo.description_zh: 通过依客户端而异的编辑、异常验证、可配置修订、非永久遮盖及按配置报价部署评估 Contentverse。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Contentverse for controlled document capture and review.
secondary_questions: Does password redaction remove the original information?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search-demand or ranking measurement.

research_gaps.en: Current workflow article timed out; no facts adopted from its search-only text. Vendor safety, compliance, availability and business outcomes not independently verified. Website terms are not a substitute for software EULA or hosting agreement.
